test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of question mark (?) in the following equation?

19.99 - 10.01 + 24.99 × 10.01 = ?
solution:
**Given:**

19.99 - 10.01 + 24.99 × 10.01

**Formula Used:**

Expression evaluation

**Calculation:**

Approximate the values:

19.99 ≈ 20

10.01 ≈ 10

24.99 ≈ 25

Substitute the approximate values into the expression:

⇒ 20 - 10 + 25 × 10

First, perform the multiplication:

⇒ 20 - 10 + 250

Next, perform the addition and subtraction:

⇒ 10 + 250

⇒ 260

**The correct answer is option 2.**
